title: Answer to an interview question
when_to_use: A spoken answer to one interview question, such as a behavioural question.
facts_hint: paste the question and the facts of the story told

personas.description: Interviewer who asks the same question to several candidates and scores each answer on a sheet.

dimensions.name: Answers the question
dimensions.question: Does the first sentence answer the question asked?

anchors.1: the answer is about something else
anchors.3: the answer gets to the question after a long setup
anchors.5: the first sentence answers the question, and the rest supports it

dimensions.name: Ownership
dimensions.question: Is it clear what the candidate did, as opposed to the team?

anchors.1: only 'we', no action of the candidate
anchors.3: some actions are the candidate's, others are vague
anchors.5: each step names what the candidate decided or did

dimensions.name: Result
dimensions.question: Does the answer end on a result and what the candidate learned?

anchors.3: a result without a number or a lesson
anchors.5: a result with a number or a scope, and one lesson the candidate names

measured.description: spoken length in seconds, 120 or fewer
